explanation: Backward: Nat.lt_of_testBit. Forward: w and k differ in some bit (Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq); all bits at positions >= k agree (both numbers are below 2^i); take j = Nat.findGreatest of the differing positions up to k. Above j the bits agree. If k had 0 and w had 1 at j, Nat.lt_of_testBit would give k < w, a contradiction.
